title: Strong Start engineering validation registry

rules.requirement: A citation's source/version ID exists.
rules.on_failure: Reject dangling references.
rules.implementation: Foreign-key/lookup of source version within authorized evidence set.
rules.minimum_fixture: Unknown version ID fails; known authorized ID passes.

rules.requirement: Stored artifact hash matches its registered version.
rules.on_failure: Hold dependent claims on integrity mismatch.
rules.implementation: SHA-256 of stored original bytes against immutable artifact record.
rules.minimum_fixture: Alter one byte after capture; integrity check fails.

rules.requirement: Referenced page or section exists.
rules.on_failure: Flag invalid source location.
rules.implementation: Resolve locator against page/section/table inventory of that version.
rules.minimum_fixture: Page 31 in a 30-page document fails.

rules.requirement: A claimed direct quote matches the stored passage under a documented normalization rule.
rules.on_failure: Flag mismatch; matching alone does not prove relevance.
rules.implementation: Compare quote to recorded passage using versioned whitespace policy.
rules.minimum_fixture: Changed digit fails; allowed whitespace difference passes.

rules.requirement: Capture succeeded and required content is nonempty.
rules.on_failure: Record capture failure instead of inventing content.
rules.implementation: Check capture status and nonempty expected extraction fields.
rules.minimum_fixture: HTTP success with empty document returns needs review.

rules.requirement: Detect identical artifact hashes and repeated candidate URLs.
rules.on_failure: Deduplicate storage/candidates while retaining provenance.
rules.implementation: Canonical-URL keys plus artifact hashes; preserve distinct capture metadata.
rules.minimum_fixture: Same bytes at two URLs share artifact, retain both origins.

rules.requirement: Detect source-version changes.
rules.on_failure: Revalidate affected requirements and claims.
rules.implementation: Compare captured content hashes and semantic record versions.
rules.minimum_fixture: Changed guideline invalidates dependent requirement snapshot.

rules.requirement: Required extraction fields and original-artifact reference are present.
rules.on_failure: Mark incomplete capture.
rules.implementation: Validate required capture metadata and resolvable original-artifact key.
rules.minimum_fixture: Missing original file reference fails ingestion readiness.

rules.requirement: Page count or extraction coverage is known and within the processed range.
rules.on_failure: Label partial document coverage.
rules.implementation: Compare processed pages to actual page inventory; flag omissions.
rules.minimum_fixture: Two pages extracted from thirty stays partial.

rules.requirement: Record parser/OCR version, warnings, and capture time.
rules.on_failure: Prevent silent loss of processing provenance.
rules.implementation: Require parser version, timestamps and explicit warning list, even empty.
rules.minimum_fixture: Missing parser version fails provenance completeness.

rules.requirement: Parse numeric values without losing sign, decimal, scale, or percent markers.
rules.on_failure: Flag ambiguous formats.
rules.implementation: Locale-aware decimal parser; retain raw value and ambiguity status.
rules.minimum_fixture: Parenthesized loss and 1.2 million retain sign/scale; ambiguous 1,234 is reviewed.
integration_dependencies: Typed verified facts and calculation inputs (A)

rules.requirement: Values fall within the defined metric's range, such as a proportion from 0 to 100%.
rules.on_failure: Flag impossible values for that metric.
rules.implementation: Metric-specific typed bounds; unknown metric has no invented bounds.
rules.minimum_fixture: 101 percent fails a bounded share; 101 percent growth is not automatically invalid.
integration_dependencies: Typed verified facts and calculation inputs (A)

rules.requirement: Claim value matches the cited structured fact.
rules.on_failure: Block altered numbers.
rules.implementation: Compare bound claim slot with verified fact/derivation using declared rounding.
rules.minimum_fixture: 94 changed to 95 fails even when both appear elsewhere.
integration_dependencies: Typed verified facts and calculation inputs (A)

rules.requirement: Claim unit/currency matches source and task.
rules.on_failure: Flag people/families, hours, CAD/USD, or scale mismatches.
rules.implementation: Match typed unit, scale and currency; require explicit conversion record.
rules.minimum_fixture: CAD treated as USD or families as children fails.
integration_dependencies: Typed verified facts and calculation inputs (A)

Unknown input is needs_review, not pass.
No rule implementation or application test result is asserted by this registry.
